comparator.name: Arts and Culture Studies
comparator.route: Arts and Culture Studies — standard domestic pathway
comparator.sourceNotes: Exact English-taught full-time BA specialisation, CROHO 56823, retained. The current official prospective year pages explicitly describe 2027–2028, 2028–2029 and 2029–2030: 60 EC first year; 30 EC second-year compulsory study and two 15-EC Faculty of Arts minors, one each semester; 20 EC third-year compulsory study, a 10-EC thesis and 30 EC free electives. The standard domestic third year appears first and is selected independently of UCR fit; it includes Conspiracy Culture, not the current older-cohort Adaptations component. The exchange pathway is a separate alternative, not added. The 2026–2027 OER confirms English ACS identity, academic aims and current conditions but its B2/B3 tables explicitly concern cohorts 2025/2024; it is not represented as the legal 2027 entrant curriculum. Known current prerequisites are Cultural Theory before Spatial Culture, Image Analysis before Visual Culture and compulsory B2 major courses before the thesis. All are compatible with this indicative sequence. Mentoring/PPO, RADAr and attendance are recorded separately. Current BSA is 45 of 60 EC. Earlier students who passed LET-ACWB708 replace the later festival course with a collective internship; this transition does not alter the new-entrant pathway. Future courses and regulations remain subject to change.

components.name: European Culture in a Global World
Two Faculty of Arts minors
components.note: Two 15-EC Faculty of Arts minors, one per second-year semester; this is structured choice space, not unrestricted electives.

components.name: BA Thesis
components.note: Required 10-EC bachelor thesis; current published progression requires completion of compulsory second-year major courses. Future regulations may change.

components.name: Free electives
components.note: 30 EC free-choice space. In the standard domestic pathway, 15 EC is taken in each semester; courses, internship and study abroad are possibilities subject to programme rules. The alternative exchange pathway is not added.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Three evidence-backed concepts respond to the defining analysis of art, cultural objects, interpretation and their historical and social contexts. The broad route combines artistic media; the second centres identity, representation and power with direct art, stylistics and adaptation replacing generic institutional politics; the third deepens text, screen and communication. Pairwise differences are 9, 5 and 12 courses. Curating and cultural-field practice remain evidenced, but the maximum of three is reached; no music, theatre or festival qualification is implied.
